title: The nonnegative Wick square concentrates at its divergent free-vacuum scale

free_vacuum_concentration.mean: For W_N=V_N+6C_N^2 on normalized T3, E(W_N)=6C_N^2=Theta(N^4)
free_vacuum_concentration.upper_bound: Since |C_N(z)|<=C_N(0), integral C_N(z)^4 dz<=C_N(0)^2 sum_k q_k^2; in d=3, C_N(0)=Theta(N^2) and sum_k q_k^2=O(N), so Var(W_N)=O(N^5)
free_vacuum_concentration.sharp_order: K1433 supplies the matching Omega(N^5) cone lower bound, hence Var(W_N)=Theta(N^5)
free_vacuum_concentration.relative_concentration: E|W_N/(6C_N^2)-1|^2=Var(W_N)/(36C_N^4)=O(N^-3), so the ratio converges to one in L2 and in probability under the free Gaussian vacuum
free_vacuum_concentration.scalar_recentering: The centered family V_N has L2 norm Theta(N^(5/2)); adding any scalar leaves its variance unchanged, so no scalar recentering makes the multiplication potentials L2 bounded
free_vacuum_concentration.ceiling: Free-vacuum concentration does not prove Mosco or strong-resolvent failure: cutoff-dependent states may move, localize or change representation, and kinetic/domain compactness still requires a separate theorem
